purpose: Generic writing style guide for documents the plugin generates, updates, and reviews: tag usage, heading levels, emphasis, document reference notation, terminology, and bans on history and related-document sections.
summary: Tag usage rules for MANDATORY, CRITICAL, and IMPORTANT, with placement and scarcity criteria
Heading levels limited to four tiers
Emphasis phrases, long-vowel omission rule (JIS Z 8301), and GFM alerts
Structured elements: code blocks with language, lists, and tables with limits
Document reference notation in three systems, using reference-style links with definitions at the end
Abstract example naming with placeholders instead of real names
No historical records or revision history sections in documents
No related-documents list sections, with exceptions for external URLs
Terminology rules: what a term is, naming principles, bracket notation, glossary files
tasks: Writing requirements documents, design documents, or plans
Editing documents that reference other documents
Adding or placing priority tags on headings
Defining terms and glossaries in documents
Writing rule or guideline documents with examples
title: 文書スタイル指針
